visualReview.notes: All7 current portable images inspected, including full tower, reverse sides, recessed door, panel seams, gallery, glazing and cap. Photographic overall proportions retained; small restored fittings remain approximate.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All7 shared-material images inspected, including native north-up polygon overlay. Painted iron, dark rail and opaque glazing render correctly. Placement heading/centroid checked; geographic mount and unload pass.

mediumFiReview.notes: All19 context images inspected: noon/late economy/high street/block/skyline, silhouette, door/gallery details and four shipped LOD transitions. Stable recognizable white tapered silhouette and dark open gallery. Surroundings are synthetic context, not Biloxi reconstruction.

geographicReview.notes: Native named lighthouse polygon and POI fix the tower center rather than the coarse story coordinate. Heading0 is an explicit approximate doorway facing on a circular tower. Unmodified standard Terrarium source field has only15cm footprint relief and the bounded own footing contacts this preview. Geographic flat-ground overlay checks loading/orientation; source-ground portable/context views check contact. Host-ground behavior remains approximate.

fidelityReview.scope: Surviving white cast-iron tower and its own footing; no demolished keeper house, roads, fencing or surrounding buildings.
fidelityReview.notes: White cast-iron taper/panel bands, recessed entrance and upper light, projecting catwalk/open dark rail, lantern frame/glazing, low rounded cap/ventilator and weathervane match the three inspected local public-domain USCG originals at approximate medium-fi exterior scope. No keeper house, fence, roads, modern visitor center or temporary maintenance scaffold.

imageryReview.notes: All3 exact local published Qualla Coast Guard originals inspected. Original source metadata, public-domain government basis and current bytes agree. Historical keeper house is excluded; restored/hidden small details remain approximate. No photographic pixels used as textures.

limitations: Approximate19.5m overall height and photographic proportions; source heights vary with measurement convention.
